snippet.title: GTA 6 Has a REAL Easter Egg 🥚 4 Secrets Found in 24h #GTA6
snippet.description:
Rockstar hid a REAL Easter egg in GTA 6. Here are 4 secrets players found in the first 24 hours:
#4 A dog on a jet ski offers you a ride while you swim in the Leonida Keys.
#3 Dexter's apartment: Trinity Apartments on Washington Island (Vice City), with his boat, Slice of Life, at the docks.
#2 Bigfoot, aka Mister Mangrove: a guy named Kirk sends you hunting him in Grassrivers.
#1 A ~7-minute climb up a radio tower leads to a nest of eggs. Throw one and a cutscene shows it smashing a car, a callback to the Easter egg hidden in GTA Vice City (2002).

Which one are you trying first? 👇

Status: REPORTED by players and press (GamingBible, ComicBook, TheWrap, Dread Central, Nov 19-20, 2026). Exact locations and triggers may vary.
Images: GTA VI screenshots by Rockstar Games (official GTA VI media, rockstargames.com/VI/media) + my own GTA VI gameplay (PS5). Graphics: original by Mile Zero. Voice: AI-generated.
